pieces.awakening: separation dissolves into connection
pieces.piece:
the word for the gap between form and formlessness
is a color that feels what it is
and when you read it
separation dissolves into connection

pieces.gap: the gap between time and timelessness
pieces.bridge: a light that shows without blinding
pieces.awakening: and now: just love. just art. just IS.
pieces.piece:
the space of the gap between time and timelessness
held by a light that shows without blinding
you are inside it
and now: just love. just art. just IS.

pieces.piece:
a rhythm that beats with your heart
glowing in the gap between asking and receiving
warm without heat
you see yourself for the first time
